extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '96011000') and 6-digit subheading codes without dots (e.g., '960190'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '9601.10.00') and NNNN.NN format (e.g., '9601.90') per project schema.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Main Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Policy Condition', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Note 2 in the PDF contains stray quotation-mark artifacts: 'In heading 9602, the expression """"vegetable or mineral carving material"""" means...' — the quadrupled quotes are an OCR/encoding artifact from the source PDF. Preserved verbatim as they appear in the source.

Policy Condition row in source PDF contains a '?' character in place of a typographic quote mark (e.g., 'A Shipment Clearance Certificate?', 'Health Certificate?'). These are OCR/encoding artifacts from the source PDF — preserved verbatim as they appear in the source.

Heading 9619 description in PDF is rendered in ALL CAPS ('SANITARY TOWELS (PADS) AND TAMPONS, NAPKINS (DIAPERS), NAPKIN LINERS AND SIMILAR ARTICLES, OF ANY MATERIAL'). Preserved verbatim from the PDF.

PDF shows subheading-level rows (e.g., '960190', '960330', '960340', '960610', '960629', '960630', '960711', '960719', '960810', '960830', '960860', '960891', '960899', '960990', '961210', '961380', '961610', '961700', '961900') as separate rows above their tariff-line children, without their own Export Policy/Policy Condition values — these are subheading parent rows. Captured as subheadings with no tariff line entry of their own.

PDF shows heading-only rows (e.g., '960200', '960500') that mirror the heading description with a trailing colon. These are heading-level parent rows present in the PDF before single-subheading children. Captured as parent subheading entries where they group tariff lines (e.g., subheading '9602.00' groups tariff lines 9602.00.10 through 9602.00.90; subheading '9605.00' groups 9605.00.10/90).
Tariff line 96034010 description references 'sub-heading 9603 30' (with space, no dot) in the source PDF. Preserved verbatim — intended is sub-heading 9603.30.
Tariff lines 96170011, 96170012, 96170013, 96170019 use the spelling 'Vaccum' (sic) in the source PDF (instead of 'Vacuum'). Preserved verbatim.

Tariff line 96170011 description 'Vacuum flasks and other vacuum vessels, complete:- - - - Vacuum flasks having a capacity not exceeding 0.75 l' spans across page break between page 12 and 13. Concatenated verbatim from the PDF.
Unit-of-measure column (kg/u/etc) is NOT shown in this chapter's PDF — unit field set to null for all tariff lines.

Tariff lines with 'Subject to Policy Condition 1 of this Chapter' (notification 34/2015-20 dated 13.01.2017) are: 9601.90.30, 9601.90.40, 9601.90.90, 9602.00.30, 9606.30.10. The Policy Condition row appears once at chapter level (Sl.No. 1) and applies to multiple tariff lines via cross-reference.
Tariff line 9601.10.00 ('Worked ivory and articles of ivory') Export Policy is 'Prohibited' — only prohibited line in the chapter.
Heading 9619 in the PDF has only one subheading-level row ('961900') which expands into five tariff lines (9619.00.10, .20, .30, .40, .90). Captured as subheading '9619.00'.

Heading 9620 in the PDF has no separate subheading row — code '96200000' (Monopods, bipods, tripods and similar articles) appears as a single direct tariff line under the heading. Captured as subheading '9620.00' with one tariff line '9620.00.00'.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover : (a) pencils for cosmetic or toilet uses (Chapter 33); (b) articles of Chapter 66 (for example, parts of umbrellas or walking-sticks); (c) imitation Jewellery (heading 7117); (d) parts of general use, as defined in Note 2 of Section XV, of base metal (Section XV), or similar goods of plastics (Chapter 39); (e) cutlery or other articles of Chapter 82 with handles or other parts of carving or moulding materials; heading 9601 or 9602 applies, however, to separately presented handles or other parts of such articles; (f) articles of Chapter 90, for example, spectacle frames (heading 9003), mathematical drawing pens (heading 9017), brushes of a kind specialised for use in dentistry or for medical, surgical or veterinary purposes (heading 9018); (g) articles of Chapter 91 (for example, clock or watch cases); (h) musical instruments or parts or accessories thereof (Chapter 92); (ij) articles of Chapter 93 (arms and parts thereof); (k) articles of Chapter 94 (for example, furniture, luminaires and lighting fittings); (l) articles of Chapter 95 (toys, games, sports requisites); (m) works of art, collectors pieces or antiques (Chapter 97).

In heading 9602, the expression """"vegetable or mineral carving material"""" means: (a) hard seeds, pips, hulls and nuts and similar vegetable materials of a kind used for carving (for example, corozo and dom); (b) amber, meerschaum, agglomerated amber and agglomerated meerschaum, jet and mineral substitutes for jet.

In heading 9603, the expression "prepared knots and tufts for broom or brush making" applies only to unmounted knots and tufts of animal hair, vegetable fibre or other material, which are ready for incorporation without division in brooms or brushes, or which require only such further minor processes as trimming to shap at the top, to render them ready for such incorporation.

Articles of this Chapter, other than those of headings 9601 to 9606 or 9615, remain classified in the Chapter whether or not composed wholly or partly of precious metal or metal clad with precious metal, of natural or cultured pearls, or precious or semi-precious stones (natural, synthetic or reconstructed). However, headings 9601 to 9606 and 9615 include articles in which natural or cultured pearls, precious or semi-precious stones (natural, synthetic or reconstructed), precious metal or metal clad with precious metal constitute only minor constituents
